descriptions.zh-Hans: 在悉尼画的菜单，完整和切开的派各占一格。
descriptions.en: A Sydney menu with room for the pie before and after cutting.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 尝过悉尼的方蛋糕后画的小菜单，椰蓉画成了点。
descriptions.en: A menu after a Sydney lamington, with coconut rendered as dots.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在悉尼歌剧院外画的原创轮廓便签，边缘很努力。
descriptions.en: An original outline drawn outside Sydney Opera House. Its margins tried their best.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制纸条，记悉尼肉派切开前后的样子。
descriptions.en: A homemade slip remembering a Sydney pie before and after the cut.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 悉尼植物园歇脚时排过的信纸小样，留了一行空白。
descriptions.en: A letter-paper trial from a Sydney garden pause, with a line left open.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的双面纸卡，一面歌剧院，一面自己看过的悉尼港。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded card with Sydney Opera House and the messenger’s harbour memory on opposite sides.
